about: Senior Machine Learning Engineer at PTC Therapeutics, leading high-impact ML and AI projects in support of PTC's mission to deliver treatments for patients with rare disorders. M.S. in Machine Learning and B.S. in Computer Science from Stevens Institute of Technology. For my Master's thesis advised by Prof. Philippos Mordohai, I studied 3D Gaussian Splatting Sparsification - shrinking 3D scene representations to an exact primitive budget while improving reconstruction quality. Interests: applied machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, 3D reconstruction, and data analysis.

projects.title: Sparsification of 3D Gaussian Splatting
projects.desc: M.S. thesis on pruning 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes to an exact primitive budget. Introduces a ground-truth-aware signed removal score and a staged population-refresh step that triples the Gaussian count before pruning back; improves 14 of 15 scene-metric comparisons on Tanks and Temples. Advised by Prof. Philippos Mordohai.
